LAREDO, Texas — Sergio David Nunez-Gonzalez was arrested Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 11:40 a.m., and booked into the Webb County Jail on four alleged felony charges involving a child, according to Webb County booking records.

The Laredo Police Department made the arrest, the records show.

The alleged charges are two counts of sexual assault of a child (second-degree felonies), one count of indecency with a child by sexual contact (a second-degree felony), and one count of indecency with a child by exposure (a third-degree felony). Bonds were set at $75,000 on each of the three second-degree felony charges and $50,000 on the third-degree felony charge.

A second-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 20 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000. A third-degree felony is punishable by two to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Sergio David Nunez-Gonzalez is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
